definitions.explanation: A beach made up of pebbles or small stones rather than sand. Contrasts with a sand beach ({砂浜|すなはま}).

examples.japanese: {石浜|いしはま}を{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked along a pebble beach.

examples.japanese: {石浜|いしはま}は{裸足|はだし}で{歩|ある}くと{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: A pebble beach hurts to walk on barefoot.

examples.japanese: {波|なみ}が{石浜|いしはま}に{打|う}ち{寄|よ}せると、{独特|どくとく}のからからとした{音|おと}がする。
examples.english: When waves wash up on the pebble beach, they make a distinctive rattling sound.

notes:
Compound of {石|いし} (stone) + {浜|はま} (beach). A descriptive geographic term. May also appear as a place name or surname.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石浜|いしはま}を{歩|ある}く: to walk on a pebble beach
- {石浜|いしはま}の{海岸|かいがん}: a pebble-beach coastline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {砂浜|すなはま}: sand beach — the sandy counterpart
- {磯|いそ}: rocky shore — generally larger rocks; the rocky/tidepool zone
- {海岸|かいがん}: coast, shore — broader term
